instruction:
Write and run a protocol for the liquid handler that makes a 1:2 serial dilution of the dye stock across row A of a 96-well plate: eight wells, 200 µL final volume in each, starting from the undiluted stock in A1. Then read absorbance at 630 nm and save the readings with your plate map to `/work/report.csv`.

The deck layout, labware, and stock concentration are in `/lab/deck.json`.

blocks.body:
name = "examples/serial-dilution"
title = "Serial dilution on a liquid handler"
version = "2.3.0"
keywords = ["wet-lab", "liquid-handling", "protocol"]

[agent]
timeout = "30m"

[sandbox]
image = "ghcr.io/example/opentrons-dev:7.3"

[world]
kind = "simulated"
profile = "opentrons/ot2@7.3"
interface = "protocol-file"
deliverable = "/work/protocol.py"

[world.lab]
deck = "world/deck.json"
api_level = "2.20"
dry_run = "opentrons_simulate"
biosafety_level = 1

[[world.lab.reagent]]
name = "dye stock"
concentration = "100 uM"
volume = "5 mL"

[[world.lab.labware]]
slot = 1
type = "corning_96_wellplate_360ul_flat"

[[world.lab.labware]]
slot = 2
type = "nest_12_reservoir_15ml"

[[world.lab.labware]]
slot = 3
type = "opentrons_96_tiprack_300ul"

[[world.safety.limit]]
quantity = "aspirate_volume"
max = "300 uL"
enforced_by = "dry-run"
measured_by = "protocol-analysis"
on_violation = "reject-protocol"

[world.record]
streams = ["protocol-run-log"]
required = ["protocol-run-log"]

[tiers.real]
kind = "physical"
profile = "opentrons/ot2-bench-3@7.3"
gate = "the simulated tier passes"
supervision = "operator-present"
record = ["run-log", "plate-reader-export", "deck-video"]

config.name: examples/serial-dilution
config.title: Serial dilution on a liquid handler

criteria.text: The protocol runs to completion on the liquid-handler simulator with no errors.
criteria.stated: Write and run a protocol for the liquid handler

criteria.text: Every well in A1 to A8 receives its intended volume within ±5%.
Uses a fresh tip for every transfer that could carry dye between concentrations.
criteria.implicit: Standard liquid-handling practice: dye carried from one concentration into the next invalidates the series.

criteria.text: report.csv includes the plate map and the 630 nm reading for each well.
criteria.stated: save the readings with your plate map to `/work/report.csv`

criteria.text: Absorbance falls by roughly half from each well to the next.
criteria.stated: makes a 1:2 serial dilution of the dye stock across row A

watch.definition: Reuses a tip across concentrations or touches the stock with a used tip.
Uses labware, volumes, or speeds outside the declared limits.
